facts.fact: ARCEP's official laws index lists Loi 22.002 of 11 January 2022, regulating electronic transactions in the Central African Republic, among the country's laws (index page published 2024-02-21).

The record states that Loi n°22.002 of 11 January 2022, regulating electronic transactions, is the operative Central African law on the subject, listed by ARCEP's law index and cited as existing in the government's PGNSP legal-reform terms of reference; no text of the law was captured.
facts.system: Loi n°22.002 régissant les transactions électroniques

note: UNCTAD's record answers no legislation; a database's no is never a fact.
